claims: The Dominican Republic is located on Hispaniola in the Caribbean.
Santo Domingo is the capital of the Dominican Republic.
Spanish is the official language of the Dominican Republic.
The currency of the Dominican Republic is the Dominican Peso (DOP).
The Dominican Republic is the birthplace of merengue.
The Dominican Republic is the birthplace of bachata.
Baseball is the most popular sport in the Dominican Republic.
Tourists from many countries do not need a visa for stays up to 30 days in the Dominican Republic.
Tourists to the Dominican Republic must complete an electronic entry/exit system called eTicket.
Passports must be valid for 6 months beyond arrival in the Dominican Republic.
There is a historic Colonial Zone in Santo Domingo.
Los Haitises National Park is in the Dominican Republic.
The U.S. Department of State website notes that completing the eTicket is required for each entry and exit to the Dominican Republic.
